app.name: THE BLUE POINT
app.tagline: From Digital Reminders to Real-World Assistance

home.heroSubtitle: Seamlessly coordinate daily well-being, healthcare access, and emergency safety for your loved ones back home.
home.trustBadge: ✓ DPDP Privacy Compliant  •  ✓ Verified Local Helpers  •  ✓ 24/7 Safety Tracking
home.workflowSubtitle: From Digital Reminders to Real-World Assistance.
home.step1Desc: Person asks for help via Simple UI or Voice.
home.step2Desc: Request is routed to Family or Verified Local Helpers.
home.step3Desc: Helper accepts and status updates in real-time.
home.step4Desc: Arrival and completion are confirmed and logged.
home.featuresSubtitle: Designed for high-impact care and daily engagement.
home.featSosDesc: Immediate alert routing with acknowledgement tracking. Never falsely displays 'Help is on the way' until a responder accepts.
home.featFamilyDesc: Shared care calendar, task assignment, due dates, and completion status so no single family member is overburdened.
home.featHelpersDesc: Physical assistance for groceries, transport, medicine pickup, and hospital accompaniment by admin-verified helpers.
home.featRemindersDesc: Medicine, meals, hydration, and daily 'I am fine' check-in confirmations.
home.featConsentDesc: Granular sharing permissions aligned with DPDP Act—the user controls who sees their location, health, or routine history.
home.featVoiceDesc: Natural-language voice interaction and local language support for seniors.
home.trustDesc1: AI & Automation facilitate routing and reminders; they never diagnose, prescribe, or make autonomous emergency decisions.
home.trustDesc2: Direct access to local emergency services is always accessible as a fallback.
home.rolesSubtitle: Choose how you want to connect with the platform.
home.footerDisclaimer: This platform is NOT a replacement for emergency services. In case of an emergency, call 112 or 108 immediately.
home.footerRights: © 2026 THE BLUE POINT. Built for the community.
